$comment: HAND-OWNED config for `pnpm rtx core drizzle-manifest` (ts-go-runtypes/cmd/gen-drizzle-manifest). The single place that says which drizzle dialects are supported: their drizzle module, the package that wraps it, and the manifest file (generated inside that package) that records coverage. Lives at the repo root: it is tool config, not a package. To add a dialect, add a row here plus the package skeleton and regenerate. `packageDir` is repo-root-relative; `proxy` and `manifest` are packageDir-relative. The same run also emits ts-go-runtypes/internal/drizzlemigrate/importmap.json, the map `mion drizzle-migrate` rewrites imports with; `migrateAlias` is the only hand-owned input to it (see the root row).

dialects.$migrateAliasComment: A migrated name whose DRIZZLE spelling is still needed in the same file, so the two cannot share a local. `sql` is the only one: drizzle's builds queries (db.execute(sql`...`)) while ours records authoring sql (.default(sql`now()`)), and drizzle's own suites use both. drizzle-migrate imports ours under the alias and uses it only inside recorder calls.
